pages.text: Wear in a Curios $(thing)head$() slot.$(li)See about 32 blocks through Phase 5 and early Phase 6 whiteout$(li)Keeps blown ice off your face$(li)No help once the air starts thinning$(br2)With an ORSA Thermal Visor also worn: $(thing)V$() for thermal, $(thing)B$() for blizzard optics.
Standard goggles shattered at -80°C. Field teams wrapped salvage cloth and leather around glass. Ugly, functional.
